title: Multivariable Extremum Seeking for Locally Lipschitz Objectives
summary: Classical extremum seeking (ES) is commonly interpreted as approximating gradient descent, but this interpretation is less clear for nonsmooth objectives in the continuous-time multivariable setting. We propose a minimal modification of the classical multivariable perturbation--demodulation architecture: rationally independent perturbation frequencies and matched demodulation signals.
